source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hi, everything looks great so far. Option 2 is closer to the direction we want. Since we have 4 bundles, could the pricing section contain 4 boxes? Could we also reduce the amount of blue on the home screen so the image receives more emphasis? We still want some blue, but just a little less. Could basic animation also be added to the gallery on the home page? For pricing, could we include a button or section [PERSON_NAME_004] directs users to more detailed pricing information? [PERSON_NAME_003] you!

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hi, the home page looks excellent. On the services page, could we include an image corresponding to each service offered? I would like to visually feature the photo, twilights, floor plan, 3d, etc. Because we are primarily a photography business, I want every page to be highly visual and image-focused. Could we remove the monthly and annual tabs from the services page? Our pricing is one-time only. Could we also provide four bundle spaces rather than 3? In addition, could we add a large diagram showing all the individual services we offer? I prefer complete pricing transparency so customers can select individual items when necessary and understand exactly how the pricing is divided. I am attaching a PDF containing every item [PERSON_NAME_004] needs to be included. Most items are also grouped according to price and the house's square footage. I like the gallery design. The only necessary tabs are photos, twilights, videos, floor plans, and 3d tour. There could perhaps be a smaller area for other photography, since we occasionally take one-off clients. During development of the actual website, could the gallery items have hover animations? The pages are looking excellent!

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hi, everything is looking great! I have a couple of items. I believe there is a glitch in the gallery, and I’ve recorded a clip showing it below. Could we also disable hover animations in the mobile version? Since touching the screen is the only way to hover there, I find the effect somewhat jarring. It would also be a bonus if the mobile pricing sheet could be reformatted so all information is visible without scrolling right. I understand if it is too late to make [PERSON_NAME_004] change because implementation of the site has already begun. Lastly, can the home-screen buttons link to the relevant pages—gallery, pricing, and services? Currently, they appear to return users to the top of the home page.

source_message.speaker: agency
source_message.text:
Hello [PERSON_NAME_001],

Here is a brief update.

The homepage buttons have been revised and now lead directly to the corresponding Gallery, Pricing, and Services pages.

As for the hover animations, WordPress Elementor has a limitation in this situation. Elementor does not support separate mobile and desktop hover settings here, so removing the effects from mobile would also remove them from the desktop version.

Please confirm whether you want the hover effects removed altogether or would rather leave them unchanged.

[PERSON_NAME_005] also waiting to hear which pricing-table approach you prefer, so we can implement the option [PERSON_NAME_004] best meets your needs.

[PERSON_NAME_003] you!

ambiguity.description: Elementor cannot configure hover effects separately for mobile and desktop, leaving unresolved whether to remove the effects everywhere or retain them everywhere.
